obtain ⟨T,hT⟩ := Work.A04.finite_faithful _ (observes H D)
  obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := hs T
  have hv (I : Watch C) (χ : E4 → ℝ) (hh : Window I.held χ) :
      flux J χ U I.held (S.classTokens ∘ I.q) v = I.tester S D B := by
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hs (insert I T)
    have ht : b=B := hT (funext (fun y : T => (hb y.val (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem y.property)).symm.trans (hB y y.property)))
    exact (unchanged_flux H h hc v U hw hl _ I.distinct hh (hW I) _).trans (ht ▸ hb I (Finset.mem_insert_self ..))

proof_context.conclusion: A finite faithful family `T` exists (`finite_faithful`), the matching field is unique, and adjoining any watch `I` gives the same field, so the flux of every watch equals its tester on `B`.

refine ⟨B,fun n q x hx χ hχ => ?_⟩
  refine tendsto_nhds_unique_of_frequently_eq (continuous_flux H hx hχ U (fun i => (hw i).continuous) J q v)
    (cont_disc H (Fin.cons ⟨D,B⟩ q) hx).continuousAt ?_
  refine (((meets_grid C x).and_eventually (valid_nearby hx hχ)).mono ?_)
  rintro y ⟨⟨hp,k,w,rfl⟩,_,hz⟩
  obtain ⟨_,s,u,z,rfl,hp',hu,rfl⟩ := raised (C:=C) k hp q
  let I : Watch C := ⟨n,k,z,u,hp'⟩
  rw [← hu] at hz ⊢
  change flux J χ (fun y => U (y - Points.across s I.held 0)) (Points.across s I.held) (S.classTokens ∘ u) v =
    disc _ (Points.across s I.held)
  rw [moves_flux H I.distinct s U J _ v (show Window (Points.across s I.held) χ from hz),
    slide_disc H I.held s I.distinct,show (fun y => U (y-I.held 0)) = U from funext fun y => by rw [I.origin,sub_zero]]
  exact (hv I _ (moves_window s hz)).trans (Watch.test_known _ _)

proof_context.conclusion: Continuity of `flux` and `disc` extends the identity from grid points to all separated configurations, and `moves_flux` and `slide_disc` move the distinguished point to arbitrary `x 0`.

let T : SpinRows S := fun d => { toFun := R d
                                   map_add' := ?_, map_smul' := ?_ }
  · refine ⟨P,T,fun {n} {x} hx q {χ} w b d B => ?_,fun {n} {x} hx q {χ} w k d B => ?_⟩
    · rw [← flux_translation,hP]; exact hX d b B n q x hx _ w
    rw [← flux_spin,← front_eval]; exact (hu q k d B x hx _ w).symm
  · intro a b; apply LinearMap.ext; intro v
    apply S.field_ext H.laws.toSymmetric; intro n q x hx
    obtain ⟨χ,hχ⟩ := exists_window x hx
    change S.useAt S _ _ = S.useAt S x (Fin.cons ⟨d,R d a v+R d b v⟩ q)
    rw [← front_eval,← front_eval,map_add]; simp only [hu _ _ _ _ _ hx χ hχ,map_add]
  intro r k; apply LinearMap.ext; intro v; apply S.field_ext H.laws.toSymmetric; intro n q x hx
  obtain ⟨χ,hχ⟩ := exists_window x hx
  change S.useAt S _ _ = S.useAt S x (Fin.cons ⟨d,r • R d k v⟩ q)
  rw [← front_eval,← front_eval, show frontRead q x d (r • R d k v)=r • frontRead q x d (R d k v) from
    ((frontRead q x d).restrictScalars ℝ).map_smul .., hu q k d v _ hx χ hχ, hu q (r • k) d v _ hx χ hχ,map_smul]

proof_context.conclusion: The maps `P` (translations, complex-linear) and `T` (spin rows, real-linear) are linear, by `field_ext` and `front_eval`, and give `StressLaws` with `v = basis b` and `v = orbital k`.
